sources.title: Safety Audit Guidelines
sources.terms_note: Not checked by the agent. Reviewer to confirm the publisher's terms of use allow restating this page (open question 12).

content.mission: Control hazardous substances and, after a toxic chemical or radiological release, restore the affected area through terrain decontamination once SCDF has secured it.

sequence.label: After SCDF
sequence.action: Let SCDF carry out the initial response to save lives, mitigate the source and do preliminary site decontamination.

sequence.label: Terrain decontamination
sequence.action: Once the area is secure, carry out terrain decontamination to restore the affected area to normalcy.

hand_offs.when: A toxic chemical or radiological substance is released and lives are at risk.

review.notes: Archetype utilities is Assumed. Source is a 2013 report ("a new capability which the NEA is building up"); current arrangements to verify.
